answer: Two independent juries score the same claim, and any divergence past one grade step slashes the poster's stake. A duplicate submission forfeits the same stake before a panel is drawn, because body hashes are compared first. At the umber band the bond is 500 POA, so one duplication test costs more than a month of honest payout. A farm's near-identical text branches like a willow, one trunk with many stems, and the hash comparison sees that at the zenith of the first epoch close without a human review.
